slice: experimental v0.1 CLI admission and zero-footprint read probes

red.meaning: Before the fix, ungated --yes applied, default and dry-run materialized work/events/lock state, malformed requests could be classified writable, the delegate and land-lease probes materialized state, StatusReadOnly did not exist, and help did not disclose the experimental gate.

observed: --threshold invalid --threshold 1h exited 0, selected writable admission, and applied at 1h
--threshold 1h --threshold 2h exited 0, selected writable admission, and applied at 2h
review_red_extension.meaning: The parser used last-value-wins semantics, so an earlier malformed or duplicate threshold could be overwritten before writable admission.

invariant.support_contract: work sweep-stale mutation remains experimental and unsupported in v0.1 unless both --yes and --experimental-sweep-stale-mutations are present.
invariant.single_parser: One parser owns syntax validation, dry-run/apply selection, and writable-store classification.
invariant.admission: Invalid, conflicting, repeated, ungated, zero, negative, or excessive threshold requests fail with exit 2 before writable store open.
invariant.read_only: Default, --dry-run, help, rejected requests, delegate liveness probes, and land-lease status probes do not materialize work, events, locks, leases, or RunAttempt changes.
invariant.runtime_truth: A valid experimental apply is the only CLI shape that opens writable state.

canonical_broad_status: pending; REL-P0-004 remains fixing until the shared cross-process liveness boundary, resumable physical removal, every-boundary failure injection, and canonical broad proof pass
